experiment: P7-5.4 manual-mask SDXL inpaint corrected-canvas comparison
purpose: Separate output-canvas preservation from the requested local jacket edit on a fixed P7-5.2 preflight image.
mask_scope: Operator-defined torso and sleeve region only; face, trousers, shoes, and studio remain outside the mask.

fixed_settings.outside_mask_policy: Use the fixed source outside the feathered mask when composing the production candidate.

runs.name: low-strength preservation check
runs.finding: The corrected 512 x 768 output and masked composite preserve the full frame, but the cropped white jacket edit is almost absent.

runs.name: high-strength jacket instruction check
runs.finding: The full frame remains preserved after compositing, but the masked region becomes a gray long-sleeve top rather than the requested open cropped white denim jacket.

review.output_canvas: pass after explicitly passing width and height to the SDXL pipeline
review.outside_mask_preservation: pass in the composited candidate; raw model output is retained only for diagnosis

decision: Do not use this fixed preflight image, mask, or either candidate as a production asset. The next viable comparison must change the conditioning or model path, rather than only increase strength or steps.
